如果使用的不是 Conda 环境，也应先确认当前 Python 能够执行 `py: If you are not using a Conda environment, first confirm that the current Python can run `python -c "import lerobot"`.
根据当前工作内容选择对应流程，不需要每次都重新校准。: Choose the workflow that matches your current task. Recalibration is not required every time.
确认串口并赋予权限。: Identify the serial ports and grant access permissions.
确认机械臂能够安全回到 H 位。: Confirm that the arms can safely return to the H pose.
确认三个相机的设备编号。: Confirm the device indices of all three cameras.
调整全局相机和两个腕部相机。: Adjust the global camera and both wrist cameras.
只有在需要重新定义安装基准时，才重新生成相机参考文件。: Regenerate camera reference files only when the installation baseline needs to be redefined.
给串口赋予权限。: Grant access permissions to the serial ports.
核对串口和相机编号。: Check the serial ports and camera indices.
检查机械臂 H 位。: Check the arms at the H pose.
用已有参考图检查三个相机的位置。: Use the existing reference images to check the positions of all three cameras.
进行遥操作、数据采集或模型评估。: Proceed with teleoperation, data collection or model evaluation.
使用 `lerobot-record`、RDT 客户端或 OpenPI 客户端进: Evaluate with `lerobot-record`, the RDT client or the OpenPI client.
所有运行结果统一写入仓库根目录下的 `outputs/`，不要写入 `BREE/: Write all run results to `outputs/` under the repository root, rather than to `BREE/`.
机械臂校准、H 位验证和腕部重复性验证脚本: Arm calibration, H-pose verification and wrist repeatability verification scripts
相机画面、白平衡和参考图对齐脚本: Camera-view, white-balance and reference-image alignment scripts
当前使用的相机安装参考文件: Camera installation reference files currently in use
OpenPI 代码、环境、模型、服务端和客户端: OpenPI code, environment, models, server and client
数据处理、训练、评估视频和检查结果: Data processing, training, evaluation videos and check results

重新运行 `lerobot-find-cameras opencv`，不要依赖上: Run `lerobot-find-cameras opencv` again instead of relying on indices from the previous startup. Update the camera parameters in teleoperation, data-collection and evaluation commands accordingly.
相机参考文件找不到: Camera reference files cannot be found
先检查 `BREE/camera_reference/` 中是否确实存在对应的: First check in `BREE/camera_reference/` that the corresponding `reference.json` and `reference.jpg` actually exist. Do not run `save-reference` merely to bypass the error, as this may save an incorrect installation position as the new baseline.
机械臂回到 H 位后姿态不一致: Arm poses do not match after returning to the H pose
停止实机评估，依次检查端口映射、校准 ID、校准文件和舵机安装方向。不要通过修改: Stop real-robot evaluation and check the port mapping, calibration IDs, calibration files and servo installation orientation in that order. Do not modify task reference images to conceal an arm calibration problem.
命令中的任务路径不存在: A task path in a command does not exist
本文档中的 `YOUR_NAME`、`YOUR_DATASET`、`YOUR_T: The `YOUR_NAME`, `YOUR_DATASET`, `YOUR_TASK`, `YOUR_RUN` and `PATH_TO_RDT_CHECKPOINT` values in this document are placeholders that must be replaced. Before running, use `test -e <路径>` or `ls <路径>` to confirm that the actual files exist.
